title: A gnat interrupts the interview
summary: Brown and Young swat at a gnat and joke about it.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I don‘t know, but if it‘s bothering me, I don‘t know.
He‘s trying to bite me. You got it, no you didn‘t, you missed him.
You get him? You‘re faster than me. [laughs] We‘re getting this all on tape.
He was right on the thing. Well, I‘ll be darn. [bang] [laughs] I think you missed it twice!
Don‘t hit him no more! [laughs] Boy, that thing is something else. Where did he come from?
[laughs] He‘s a big fan! He‘s a gnat, a little gnat, a little gnat. Dang, he‘ll be coming after me now.
I‘m glad it ain‘t but one.
Well, you go ahead and talk if he‘s on me, go ahead. [laughs]
Well, I‘m glad it ain‘t but one. ‗Cause if there was more than one…
Well, he‘s on me, he‘s not on you, you go ahead. Young:…we‘d be in trouble.
